description: Create and publish surveys, quizzes, and forms; manage projects and responses; analyze results and generate reports in WebAsk.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http webask https://mcp.webask.io/mcp/v1 --header "Authorization: Bearer $WEBASK_API_KEY"

notes: Send a WebAsk API key as an Authorization bearer token. Create the key under Settings > API / MCP in WebAsk.
Repository, documentation, license, and hosted endpoint authentication response were checked during maintainer review.

license: MIT (repository docs, configs, and skills); hosted WebAsk service is proprietary
